Chapter 1233 - 39: Another Wonderful Use Of The Treasure Land (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1233: Chapter 39: Another Wonderful Use of the Treasure Land (Please Subscribe)

After refining all the core pillars and fully mastering the treasure land, Lin Yuan’s spirit soared infinitely, arriving at the ’connection’ between the treasure land and the source world.

The relationship between the treasure land and the source world is akin to fruit and the mother tree.

A newly emerged treasure land is equivalent to fruit about to fall from the mother tree.

About to disconnect, yet not completely severed.

Thus, through such a treasure land, following the unbroken link, one can observe the vast Origin Source of the source world.

Only newly emerged treasure lands can do this; those that have existed for countless ages, even first-class treasure lands, have no relation to the mother tree anymore.

The Hei Yu Nest and Greenwave Cliff guarded by Lin Yuan are such, essentially completely independent.

"Origin Source of the source world?"

Lin Yuan looked into the distance, where there was an irregular crack connected to the deepest part of the source world.

Only after fully refining and mastering every newly born treasure land can one have the opportunity to comprehend the Origin Source of the source world.

Every time a treasure land emerges, the Peak Venerables of the great ancient countries compete for participation slots, not just because the yields within the treasure land belong entirely to them.

This is also one of the reasons.

How vast is the operation of the Origin Source of the source world? It’s a fluctuation that even the ancestors of the great ancient countries could not fully replicate, offering an unprecedented accumulation for the Peak Venerables.

Lin Yuan’s gaze was fixed on the irregular crack, faintly looking into its depths.

In an instant, a wave of shock surged in Lin Yuan’s heart, gaining a ’concrete’ understanding of the operation of the Origin Source of the source world.

In Lin Yuan’s sight, the Origin Source of the source world was a towering ’giant tree’, each leaf gently swaying, containing countless waves of Dao rule information, with countless leaves echoing and intertwining, together forming this vast world.

The ’giant tree’ is so vast and profound that words cannot describe it. Lin Yuan’s strength is considered that of an Invincible Venerable in the history of the six great ancient countries, yet in front of the ’giant tree’, he is still like dust.

Lin Yuan even had a feeling that, compared to the ’giant tree’, even the high ancestors are still small and insignificant.

Just by watching for a moment, a flood of insights and thoughts poured into Lin Yuan’s heart.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to view unknown Origin Source manifestations, enhancing your comprehension of Dao rules...]

"Origin Source of the source world, is this the Origin Source of the source world?"

Lin Yuan took a deep breath, watching the minutiae within the irregular crack with near-obsession.

As Lin Yuan watched more deeply.

The image of the Origin Source of the source world continued to change.

Initially, the Origin Source of the source world appeared as a boundless ’giant tree’, its branches and leaves forming a vast world.

After Lin Yuan gained some insight, the Origin Source of the source world turned into a winding mountain range, endless and spanning time and space.

Upon closer inspection, it transformed into a long river flowing through the ancient past and future, eternal and indestructible.

Finally, when Lin Yuan reached a certain understanding, it again became an endless ’giant tree’.

The image of the Origin Source of the source world Lin Yuan saw depended on his own thoughts; the Origin Source of the source world has no concrete form, or one could say it has infinite forms.

"Exquisite, so exquisite."

Lin Yuan murmured to himself. When treasure lands emerged in the past, the Peak Venerables of the great ancient countries had also observed the Origin Source of the source world as he did after securing a treasure land.

However, these Peak Venerables were far inferior to Lin Yuan in terms of understanding. Even watching the same scene, what they knew and felt differed greatly.

It’s like when an apple falls on someone’s head, some can grasp the basic rules of operation, while others just feel the pain.

Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, after witnessing the true operation of the Origin Source of the source world, the insights gained are incomparable to other Peak Venerables.

"This is truly the greatest opportunity I gained from contending for this treasure land."

Lin Yuan gleamed with vitality. The treasure land itself and the produced wonders are basically just external forces, however, observing the operation of the Origin Source enhances Lin Yuan’s personal insight.

...

Immersed in comprehending the operation of the Origin Source, Lin Yuan also noticed that the irregular crack connecting to the deepest part of the source world was slowly shrinking.

"The connection between the treasure land and the source world is weakening?"

Lin Yuan realized.

"Based on past experiences and the speed at which the crack is shrinking, I can comprehend for roughly ten thousand years."

Lin Yuan speculated in his heart.

Ten thousand years is but a moment for any Peak Venerable, as they can nap for over ten thousand years.

But Lin Yuan was already very satisfied.

Not every Peak Venerable has such an opportunity.

This has nothing to do with power; even with enormous strength, if such a level of treasure land doesn’t emerge, one still cannot comprehend.

Within a few thousand years of arriving in this source world, Lin Yuan witnessed the emergence of a treasure land and happened to be able to contest for it on behalf of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, which was extremely fortunate.

"I’ve felt that the comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is accelerating, reaching the Ninth Realm’s peak within a millennium, and within ten thousand years... it’s possible to surpass the Ninth Realm limit..."

While watching the crack, Lin Yuan thought quickly in his mind.

Reaching the peak of the Ninth Realm of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is an accomplishment typically attainable by only the Invincible Great Saints.

Lin Yuan’s combat strength far surpasses that of the Invincible Great Saints, but that’s through leveraging things like the Chaotic Taiji Dao, and the universe within him. In purely Spatiotemporal Fusion comprehension, he is still at the initial stage of the Ninth Realm of time-space fusion.

This is mainly because it’s only been a few hundred years since Lin Yuan entered the Ninth Realm of comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, and most of his time and effort were invested in understanding the Chaotic Taiji Dao.
